key.name: cursor-follow
key.summary: Open the clipboard history panel at the mouse pointer
key.description: When enabled, the panel opens to the right of the mouse pointer, with its bottom edge level with the pointer, and to the left when there is not enough room on the right. When disabled, it opens below the panel icon.

key.name: update-notifications
key.summary: Show a notification when an update is available

key.name: developer-mode
key.summary: Watch Clipboard History releases instead of this build's repository

key.name: checkout-path
key.summary: Folder of the repository checkout this build was installed from

key.name: update-last-check
key.summary: Time of the last update check, in seconds since 1970

key.name: update-notified
key.summary: The update that was last notified, so it is notified only once
